test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Last month, / we purchased / electronic equipments from / a European country.
solution:
The correct answer is "**electronic equipments from**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Equipments**" is **incorrect** in English.
 
• "**Equipment**" does **not** have any **plural** form.
 
• The **plural** form of "Equipment" is also "**Equipment**".
 
• Therefore, "electronic equipments from" is the incorrect segment of the sentence. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Many other words have the **same singular and plural form**.

 
 
• **Example:** *accommodation, chalk, clothing, food, homework. *
